# record-detail-layout

projectionDetail record header, metrics band, and layout.mode: "tabs" — an order screen with two relatedList tabs and a fields tab.

## README

# Record Detail Layout

Register a `projectionDetail` screen as a tabbed record view ("Akte"): a
header, a metrics band, and a tabbed layout instead of one long stacked form.

## What it shows

- `header` (title/subtitle/status) and `metrics` (each with its own i18n `label`)
  rendered from the columns of the screen's own query row
- `layout.mode: "tabs"` with two `relatedList` tabs (order items, payments)
  and one `fields` tab (master data) — each `relatedList` runs its own query
- a header action with `showOnTabs: ["payments"]`, shown only while that tab is active
- guidance for a non-expert reader: a `projectionList` with `rowToneField` (row tint),
  a `hint` column (sentence, detail, tone, "Why?" reason) and a row action shown
  only when `visible` holds; on the detail screen `breadcrumb`, `summary`, `banner`
  and `steps`, each filled from a query field and dropped when the value is empty
- `focus: true` on the detail screen: the app header actions leave the shell header and the
  sidebar shows the focus rail; below 768 px a top bar replaces the header with the record
  title, a back arrow to the list screen and the page-header overflow menu
- on phones the `orders` list draws cards in the order lead sentence (the hint column, with
  detail and "Why?"), title, up to three values, then the row action; a hint column is never
  the title and a `hideOnNarrow` one stays out of the card
- a work queue on that list: named filters as one select with hit counts (`namedFilterFacet`),
  a per-filter `sort` and `emptyState` with a reset button, a badge column, per-row button
  actions (a write "Send reminder" or a link "Open order", shown by `visible`) and a summary row footer
- a `today` dashboard on the 12-column grid: a `lead` briefing (two thirds), count tiles that
  use the list's own query and link into the filtered list, a headerless "Now" list, two third
  width lists and a money group. List and dashboard answer from `src/order-board.ts`, which the
  e2e mock dispatcher shares
- on the detail screen: a second step action as a link button, metric tiles with `tone`,
  `toneField` and `navigate: { tab }`, and tab counts via `countField`; the breadcrumb stays
  unlinked because the recipe has no entity with a `detailFor` screen to link to
- phone variants: `hideOnNarrow` on dashboard panels and the progress chain, a list panel's
  `narrow` (`cards` with a `limit`, or a one-line `line` link), `narrowBlocks` on the briefing,
  `hint.plainSentence`, `showOnNarrowOnly` list columns, stat-group `columns`, and on the detail
  `summary.narrowField` and `steps.narrowLimit`; the reason of a hint stays behind its toggle unless `reasonOpenField` opens it (with `reasonTitleField` as bold lead-in; steps use `whyOpen`/`whyTitle`)
- round 5 (board gaps): a titled `stat-group` strip with a panel `icon` and per-stat `narrowLabel`,
  `narrowOrder` on a panel, `showTotal: { text, narrowText }`, `footerLink.moreText` and
  `narrowMoreText`, `narrow: { layout: "line", field }`, `rowLink` on a list panel (arrow, or
  `icon: "chevron"` for a date list), `hint.narrowDetailField` on cards, summary row items placed
  under their `column`, and on the detail `header.narrowSubtitle`, a banner action `narrowLabel`,
  `RecordStep.narrowDetail` and a `hideOnNarrow` metric. Phone cards leave out the reason toggle
- round 6 (board gaps): `rowLink.screenField` / `paramsField` (target screen from a query field),
  list panel `icon`, `narrow.moreText`, `narrow.field` as any query output field,
  `footerLink.narrowOnly`, `narrow.titleField` on cards and `rowToneMarker: "dot"`
- boot-validator catching two common author mistakes: a `metrics` entry
  with an empty `label`, and a `tabs` layout with fewer than two
  sections

```ts
// Manual visual evidence for the board blocks (dashboard, work queue, case file), desktop and
// phone via the screenshot projects in playwright.config.ts (PADDING_PARITY_SCREENSHOTS=1).
// Captures only; the behaviour is asserted in work-queue.spec.ts.

import { expect, boundaryGuardedTest as test } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/e2e";
import type { Page } from "@playwright/test";

const PHONE_FULL_HEIGHT = 2600;
const FILTER_FACET = "facet-__namedFilter";

// Phones keep the facets behind a "Filters" button.
async function openFilterSelect(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  const facet = page.getByTestId(FILTER_FACET);
  if (!(await facet.isVisible())) await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Filters" }).click();
  await facet.click();
}

test("board: today dashboard", async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
  await page.goto("/today");
  await expect(page.getByText("Inbox")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText("Send payment reminder").first()).toBeVisible();
  await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath("today.png"), fullPage: true });
});

test("board: orders list in its states", async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
  await page.goto("/orders");
  await expect(page.getByText("SO-10483")).toBeVisible();
  await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath("orders.png"), fullPage: true });

  await openFilterSelect(page);
  await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath("orders-select-open.png"), fullPage: true });
  await page.getByTestId(`${FILTER_FACET}-action-needed`).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("SO-10483")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath("orders-filtered.png"), fullPage: true });

  // The reason sits behind its toggle in the table; the phone cards leave it out.
  const reasonToggle = page.locator("[data-hint-reason-toggle]").first();
  if (await reasonToggle.isVisible()) {
    await reasonToggle.click();
    await expect(page.locator("[data-hint-reason]").first()).toBeVisible();
  }
  await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath("orders-reason-open.png"), fullPage: true });

  await openFilterSelect(page);
  await page.getByTestId(`${FILTER_FACET}-reminder-due`).click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("render-list-empty-reset-filter")).toBeVisible();
  await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath("orders-empty.png"), fullPage: true });
});

test("board: order detail with a step reason open", async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
  await page.goto("/order-detail/o1?guidance=1");
  await expect(page.getByTestId("render-edit-form")).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: /why/i }).first().click();
  // The shell scrolls inside <main>, so fullPage alone would cut a phone capture at the viewport.
  const viewport = page.viewportSize();
  if (viewport !== null && viewport.width < 768) {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: viewport.width, height: PHONE_FULL_HEIGHT });
  }
  await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath("order-detail.png"), fullPage: true });
});
```

### e2e/build-server.ts

```ts
// Tiny Bun server that builds and serves the e2e bundle — same shape as
// writeform-section/e2e/build-server.ts, radically stripped down (no
// Postgres, no auth). The MockDispatcher (fixtures/mock-dispatcher.ts)
// replaces the whole stack.
//
// The AppSchema is NOT duplicated in the client bundle (drift risk against
// the real feature code). Instead this server process builds the schema
// from the real src/feature.ts via createRegistry + buildAppSchema (both
// pure, no DB/HTTP) and serves it as JSON over /schema.json — client.tsx
// fetches it on boot.
//
// Port 4190: 4172-4189 are taken by other samples/apps (see their
// playwright.config.ts/package.json), 4190 is free.
//
// /styles.css is REALLY compiled from Tailwind (not stubbed) — this recipe
// exists to prove a real box-model fix (fw#2778: a relatedList tab panel
// must size to its content, not stretch to fill). Without real CSS the
// getBoundingClientRect() measurements in height.spec.ts would be against
// unstyled browser default flow, not the actual flex chain under test.
// Entry stylesheet = fixtures/styles.css, a local wrapper that re-exports
// renderer/web's styles.css and adds an @source covering this e2e dir.
//
// One-shot build, no watcher (the server only runs for the test duration)
// — dies hard on a Tailwind CLI/build failure instead of degrading to an
// empty stylesheet and letting the layout assertions pass vacuously.

import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join, resolve } from "node:path";
import { buildAppSchema, createRegistry } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import {
  canResolveTailwindStylesheet,
  resolveTailwindCli,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime/resolve-tailwind-cli";
import { createOrderDeskFeature } from "../src/feature";

const HERE = resolve(import.meta.dir);
const ENTRY = resolve(HERE, "fixtures/client.tsx");
const HTML_PATH = resolve(HERE, "fixtures/index.html");

async function buildStylesheet(): Promise<string> {
  const cliPath = resolveTailwindCli({ bun: Bun, cwd: HERE });
  if (cliPath === undefined) {
    throw new Error(
      "record-detail-layout/e2e: @tailwindcss/cli not resolvable — run `bun install` at the repo root.",
    );
  }
  const entryCss = resolve(HERE, "fixtures/styles.css");
  if (!canResolveTailwindStylesheet(entryCss, { bun: Bun, cwd: HERE })) {
    throw new Error(
      `record-detail-layout/e2e: tailwindcss not resolvable for ${entryCss} — peer dependency missing at the stylesheet's location.`,
    );
  }
  const outDir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "record-detail-layout-e2e-tw-"));
  try {
    const outPath = join(outDir, "styles.css");
    const bunBin = process.argv[0] ?? "bun";
    const build = Bun.spawnSync([bunBin, "run", cliPath, "-i", entryCss, "-o", outPath], {
      cwd: HERE,
    });
    if (!build.success) {
      throw new Error(
        `record-detail-layout/e2e: tailwind build failed (exit ${build.exitCode})\n${build.stderr.toString()}`,
      );
    }
    return await Bun.file(outPath).text();
  } finally {
    rmSync(outDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

const css = await buildStylesheet();

const port = Number(process.env["PORT"] ?? 4190);

const registry = createRegistry([createOrderDeskFeature()]);
const schema = buildAppSchema(registry);
const schemaJson = JSON.stringify(schema);

const built = await Bun.build({
  entrypoints: [ENTRY],
  target: "browser",
  sourcemap: "linked",
});

if (!built.success) {
  // biome-ignore lint/suspicious/noConsole: e2e build script — no logger wired
  for (const log of built.logs) console.error(log);
  throw new Error("record-detail-layout/e2e: client bundle failed");
}

const jsOutput = built.outputs.find((o) => o.path.endsWith(".js"));
const mapOutput = built.outputs.find((o) => o.path.endsWith(".js.map"));
if (!jsOutput) throw new Error("record-detail-layout/e2e: bundle has no .js output");

const js = await jsOutput.text();
const map = mapOutput ? await mapOutput.text() : "";
const html = await Bun.file(HTML_PATH).text();

Bun.serve({
  port,
  fetch(req: Request): Response {
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    if (url.pathname === "/client.js") {
      return new Response(js, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/javascript; charset=utf-8" },
      });
    }
    if (url.pathname === "/client.js.map") {
      return new Response(map, { headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" } });
    }
    if (url.pathname === "/schema.json") {
      return new Response(schemaJson, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" },
      });
    }
    if (url.pathname === "/styles.css") {
      return new Response(css, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/css; charset=utf-8" } });
    }
    if (url.pathname === "/api/sse" || url.pathname.startsWith("/sse")) {
      const stream = new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
        start(controller) {
          controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode(": connected\n\n"));
        },
      });
      return new Response(stream, {
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "text/event-stream",
          "Cache-Control": "no-cache",
          Connection: "keep-alive",
        },
      });
    }
    return new Response(html, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } });
  },
});

// biome-ignore lint/suspicious/noConsole: e2e build script — no logger wired
console.log(`record-detail-layout/e2e build-server listening on http://localhost:${port}`);
```

### e2e/fixtures/client.tsx

```tsx
// Browser entry for record-detail-layout/e2e (fw#2778). Fetches the
// server-built AppSchema (built from the real src/feature.ts, see
// build-server.ts) and mounts createKumikoApp with the MockDispatcher.
//
// Pattern copied from writeform-section/e2e/fixtures/client.tsx: the shell
// renders its own explicitly-keyed KumikoScreen (entityId="order-1") instead
// of createKumikoApp's routed `children` — that's the only way to pin a
// projectionDetail screen's entityId without forking the URL-routing
// internals. `screenQn` is still required (createKumikoApp throws without a
// resolvable initial route), but the routed content it produces is unused.
//
// DefaultAppShell wraps the screen in the same viewport-height chrome
// (`h-svh` shell, `main` scrolls internally) a real app gives it — the
// fillHeight/scrollBody chain under test only resolves against a genuinely
// height-constrained ancestor, not document-flow. `user` grants the
// "Admin" role order-detail's screen access requires.
//
// order-detail is a projectionDetail screen in `layout.mode: "tabs"` — the
// first tab ("items", a relatedList section) is active by default (no `tab`
// search param), which is exactly the fw#2778 scenario: a lone relatedList
// tab that must size to its content when short and scroll internally when
// long, instead of stretching the tab panel to the bottom.

import type { AppSchema } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer";
import { ExtensionSectionsProvider } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer";
import { createKumikoApp, DefaultAppShell, KumikoScreen } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/web";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { createMockDispatcher } from "./mock-dispatcher";

const ORDER_DETAIL_SCREEN_QN = "order-desk:screen:order-detail";

// Plugin-mounted "extension" tab (fw#3234 padding-parity screenshots) — no
// own Card/Section, exactly what guard-no-framed-extension-sections
// enforces: the host's own tabs-mode Card is the only frame this gets.
function OrderInternalNote(): ReactNode {
  const tallPx = Number.parseInt(
    new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("noteHeight") ?? "",
    10,
  );
  return (
    <div>
      <p data-testid="order-internal-note">
        Handled by Jonas Weber, escalate if unpaid past Sep 1.
      </p>
      {Number.isFinite(tallPx) && tallPx > 0 && (
        <>
          <div style={{ height: tallPx }} />
          <p data-testid="order-internal-note-end">End of note</p>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function OrderInboxIcon(): ReactNode {
  return (
    <svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none">
      <path d="M2 9h3l1 2h4l1-2h3v4H2z" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function DeadlinesIcon(): ReactNode {
  return (
    <svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none">
      <rect x="2" y="3" width="12" height="11" rx="1.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" />
      <path d="M2 7h12M5 1.5v3M11 1.5v3" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function Shell({
  schema,
  children,
}: {
  readonly children: ReactNode;
  readonly schema: AppSchema;
}): ReactNode {
  const feature = schema.features[0];
  // Only the root path pins the record; other paths (/today, /orders) render the routed screen.
  const isPinnedRecord = window.location.pathname === "/";
  // KumikoScreen sits directly under DefaultAppShell's <main> — same as the
  // real RoutedScreen (create-app.tsx) — so RenderEdit's `fillHeight` chain
  // (h-full all the way down) resolves against `main`'s own, genuinely
  // height-constrained box. A wrapper div here without its own h-full would
  // break that percentage-height chain at the very first link.
  return (
    <DefaultAppShell
      brand={<span>Order Desk</span>}
      schema={schema}
      user={{ id: "u1", roles: ["Admin"] }}
    >
      <ExtensionSectionsProvider value={{ OrderInboxIcon, DeadlinesIcon, OrderInternalNote }}>
        {isPinnedRecord && feature !== undefined ? (
          <KumikoScreen schema={feature} qn={ORDER_DETAIL_SCREEN_QN} entityId="order-1" />
        ) : (
          children
        )}
      </ExtensionSectionsProvider>
    </DefaultAppShell>
  );
}

async function boot(): Promise<void> {
  const root = document.getElementById("root");
  if (root === null) throw new Error("record-detail-layout/e2e: #root not found");

  const response = await fetch("/schema.json");
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`record-detail-layout/e2e: /schema.json fetch failed with ${response.status}`);
  }
  const schema = (await response.json()) as AppSchema;

  createKumikoApp({
    schema,
    dispatcher: createMockDispatcher(),
    shell: Shell,
    screenQn: ORDER_DETAIL_SCREEN_QN,
  });
}

boot().catch((error: unknown) => {
  const root = document.getElementById("root");
  if (root !== null) {
    root.textContent = `record-detail-layout/e2e: boot failed — ${String(error)}`;
  }
  throw error;
});
```

### e2e/fixtures/mock-dispatcher.ts

```ts
// In-memory dispatcher for record-detail-layout/e2e (fw#2778). Same shape as
// writeform-section/e2e/fixtures/mock-dispatcher.ts — implements only the
// three query QNs order-desk's projectionDetail screen needs:
//
//   - "order-desk:query:order:detail" — the screen's own header/metrics row.
//   - "order-desk:query:order:items"  — the "items" relatedList tab.
//   - "order-desk:query:order:payments" — the "payments" relatedList tab.
//
// The "items" row count is driven by the page's own `?items=<n>` URL param
// (read at query time, not baked into the fixture) so the same server can
// back both the short-list and long-list layout measurements the
// fw#2778 fix needs — a fixed row count would need two fixtures.

import type {
  BatchResult,
  Command,
  Dispatcher,
  DispatcherStatus,
  PendingFile,
  PendingWrite,
  QueryOpts,
  QueryResult,
  Store,
  WriteOpts,
  WriteResult,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/headless";
import {
  answerBriefing,
  answerCustomers,
  answerDeadlines,
  answerMoney,
  answerNowList,
  answerOrderDetail,
  answerOrderList,
  answerOrderSummary,
  orderListSchema,
  orderSummarySchema,
} from "../../src/order-board";

const QUERY_ORDER_LIST = "order-desk:query:order:list";
const QUERY_ORDER_SUMMARY = "order-desk:query:order:summary";
const QUERY_ORDER_NOW = "order-desk:query:order:now";
const QUERY_ORDER_BRIEFING = "order-desk:query:order:briefing";
const QUERY_ORDER_DEADLINES = "order-desk:query:order:deadlines";
const QUERY_ORDER_CUSTOMERS = "order-desk:query:order:customers";
const QUERY_ORDER_MONEY = "order-desk:query:order:money";
const QUERY_ORDER_DETAIL = "order-desk:query:order:detail";
const QUERY_ORDER_ITEMS = "order-desk:query:order:items";
const QUERY_ORDER_PAYMENTS = "order-desk:query:order:payments";

// The guidance blocks (breadcrumb, summary, banner, progress, steps) stack tall above the tabs;
// the height specs measure the tab panel and run without them, `?guidance=1` turns them on.
function orderDetailForUrl(id: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  const {
    path,
    summaryLine,
    summaryShort,
    summaryTone,
    notice,
    steps,
    progress,
    ...withoutGuidance
  } = answerOrderDetail(id);
  const withGuidance = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).has("guidance");
  return withGuidance
    ? { ...withoutGuidance, path, summaryLine, summaryShort, summaryTone, notice, steps, progress }
    : withoutGuidance;
}

function itemsCountFromUrl(): number {
  const raw = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("items");
  const parsed = raw === null ? Number.NaN : Number.parseInt(raw, 10);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 3;
}

function buildItemRows(count: number): Array<Record<string, unknown>> {
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({
    sku: `KB-${100 + i}`,
    description: `Item ${i + 1}`,
    quantity: 1,
    unitPrice: 10 + i,
  }));
}

const ONLINE_STORE: Store<DispatcherStatus> = {
  getSnapshot: () => "online",
  subscribe: () => () => {},
};

export function createMockDispatcher(): Dispatcher {
  async function write<TData = unknown>(type: string): Promise<WriteResult<TData>> {
    throw new Error(`mock-dispatcher: unsupported write qn "${type}"`);
  }

  async function query<TData = unknown>(
    type: string,
    payload: unknown,
    _opts?: QueryOpts,
  ): Promise<QueryResult<TData>> {
    if (type === QUERY_ORDER_DETAIL) {
      const data = (payload ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>; // @cast-boundary mock-dispatcher wire payload
      const id = (data["id"] as string | undefined) ?? "order-1";
      return { isSuccess: true, data: orderDetailForUrl(id) as unknown as TData };
    }
    if (type === QUERY_ORDER_LIST) {
      const answer = answerOrderList(orderListSchema.parse(payload ?? {}));
      return { isSuccess: true, data: answer as unknown as TData };
    }
    if (type === QUERY_ORDER_SUMMARY) {
      const answer = answerOrderSummary(orderSummarySchema.parse(payload ?? {}));
      return { isSuccess: true, data: answer as unknown as TData };
    }
    if (type === QUERY_ORDER_NOW) {
      return { isSuccess: true, data: answerNowList() as unknown as TData };
    }
    if (type === QUERY_ORDER_BRIEFING) {
      return { isSuccess: true, data: answerBriefing() as unknown as TData };
    }
    if (type === QUERY_ORDER_DEADLINES) {
      return { isSuccess: true, data: answerDeadlines() as unknown as TData };
    }
    if (type === QUERY_ORDER_CUSTOMERS) {
      return { isSuccess: true, data: answerCustomers() as unknown as TData };
    }
    if (type === QUERY_ORDER_MONEY) {
      return { isSuccess: true, data: answerMoney() as unknown as TData };
    }
    if (type === QUERY_ORDER_ITEMS) {
      return { isSuccess: true, data: { rows: buildItemRows(itemsCountFromUrl()) } as TData };
    }
    if (type === QUERY_ORDER_PAYMENTS) {
      return {
        isSuccess: true,
        data: {
          rows: [
            { paidAt: "2026-08-21", amount: 936, method: "card", status: "settled" },
            { paidAt: "2026-08-25", amount: 312, method: "invoice", status: "pending" },
          ],
        } as TData,
      };
    }
    throw new Error(`mock-dispatcher: unsupported query qn "${type}"`);
  }

  async function batch(commands: readonly Command[], opts?: WriteOpts): Promise<BatchResult> {
    const results: WriteResult[] = [];
    for (const cmd of commands) results.push(await write(cmd.type, cmd.payload, opts));
    return { isSuccess: true, results };
  }

  return {
    write,
    query,
    batch,
    statusStore: ONLINE_STORE,
    async *stream() {},
    pendingWrites: (): readonly PendingWrite[] => [],
    pendingFiles: (): readonly PendingFile[] => [],
  };
}
```

### e2e/height.spec.ts

```ts
// Tab-panel height spec (fw#2778): a relatedList tab in a projectionDetail
// "Akte" (order-detail's default "items" tab) must size to its content when
// the list is short, and cap at the panel's available height (scrolling
// internally) when the list is long — never stretch the card to the bottom
// of the panel regardless of row count. No hardcoded pixel positions: every
// assertion compares the card's live box model against `main`'s (the real,
// viewport-height-constrained ancestor from DefaultAppShell) and against
// itself across the two row-count scenarios.
//
// `?items=<n>` (read by fixtures/mock-dispatcher.ts) switches between the
// short-list and long-list scenario without needing two fixtures.

import { expect, boundaryGuardedTest as test } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/e2e";
import type { Page } from "@playwright/test";

async function gotoOrderDetail(page: Page, items: number): Promise<void> {
  await page.goto(`/?items=${items}`);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("render-edit-form")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("render-list-table")).toBeVisible();
}

function mainLocator(page: Page) {
  return page.locator("main").first();
}

// Structural, not class-name-coupled: FormScreenShell renders exactly one
// wrapping div holding [headerRegion-wrapper?, card] as direct children —
// the card (cardSurface()) is always the last of those (see DefaultForm in
// packages/renderer/src/web/primitives/index.tsx).
function cardLocator(page: Page) {
  return page.locator('[data-testid="render-edit-form"] > div > div').last();
}

function tabsLocator(page: Page) {
  return page.getByTestId("kumiko-screen-projection-detail-tabs");
}

test.describe("record-detail-layout — tab-panel height", () => {
  // The design refresh (#3381) made detail tabs a full-bleed "board": the
  // relatedList scroll region fills the panel down to the footer instead of
  // the card sizing to its rows (fw#2778's original behavior). What must
  // still hold: the rows themselves keep their natural height, and the
  // region never exceeds the panel.
  test("short list: the scroll region fills the panel while the table keeps its content height", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await gotoOrderDetail(page, 3);
    const main = await mainLocator(page).boundingBox();
    const region = await page.getByTestId("render-list-table-scroll").boundingBox();
    const table = await page.getByTestId("render-list-table").boundingBox();
    if (main === null || region === null || table === null) throw new Error("missing bounding box");
    expect(region.y + region.height).toBeLessThanOrEqual(main.y + main.height + 4);
    expect(table.height).toBeLessThan(region.height);
    expect(table.height).toBeLessThan(main.height * 0.4);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("render-list-table-footer")).toBeVisible();
  });

  test("long list: the tab-panel card is capped at the panel's available height and the table scrolls internally", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await gotoOrderDetail(page, 60);
    const main = await mainLocator(page).boundingBox();
    const card = await cardLocator(page).boundingBox();
    if (main === null || card === null) throw new Error("missing bounding box");
    // Card never exceeds the panel height it's confined to (small tolerance
    // for the header card's own margin above it).
    expect(card.height).toBeLessThanOrEqual(main.height + 4);

    // The document itself does not grow with the row count — the table
    // scrolls INSIDE the card, the page never gets a body scrollbar.
    const scrollHeight = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollHeight);
    const viewportHeight = await page.evaluate(() => window.innerHeight);
    expect(scrollHeight).toBeLessThanOrEqual(viewportHeight + 4);

    // Some ancestor between the <table> and the card actually clips and
    // scrolls its content (tableInner's own `overflow-y-auto` div — the
    // `<table>` sits inside an extra `overflow-x-auto` wrapper from
    // ui/table.tsx first, whose reported `overflow-y` computed value is
    // "auto" too per the CSS overflow-x/y coupling rule even though it
    // never actually clips vertically, so this checks the real effect
    // (scrollHeight > clientHeight) rather than the computed style). That's
    // the "scrolls in place" half of the fix — the previous assertion
    // already proved the card doesn't grow to make room for it instead.
    const tableWrapperOverflows = await page.getByTestId("render-list-table").evaluate((table) => {
      let el: HTMLElement | null = table.parentElement;
      while (el !== null && el.scrollHeight <= el.clientHeight + 1) {
        el = el.parentElement;
      }
      return el !== null;
    });
    expect(tableWrapperOverflows).toBe(true);
  });

  test("record header (subtitle, metrics) and tab strip stay fully visible, uncompressed, in both scenarios", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    const subtitle = page.getByTestId("kumiko-screen-projection-detail-subtitle");
    const metrics = page.getByTestId("kumiko-screen-projection-detail-metrics");
    const heights: { tabs: number; subtitle: number; metrics: number }[] = [];
    for (const items of [3, 60]) {
      await gotoOrderDetail(page, items);
      const tabs = await tabsLocator(page).boundingBox();
      if (tabs === null) throw new Error(`missing tabs bounding box (items=${items})`);
      expect(tabs.height).toBeGreaterThan(20);
      // The title now lives in the shell's page header, not in the screen.
      await expect(subtitle).toBeVisible();
      await expect(metrics).toBeVisible();
      const subtitleBox = await subtitle.boundingBox();
      const metricsBox = await metrics.boundingBox();
      if (subtitleBox === null || metricsBox === null) {
        throw new Error(`missing header bounding box (items=${items})`);
      }
      heights.push({ tabs: tabs.height, subtitle: subtitleBox.height, metrics: metricsBox.height });
      for (const region of [subtitle, metrics]) {
        const clipped = await region.evaluate((el) => el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 1);
        expect(clipped).toBe(false);
      }
    }
    const [few, many] = heights;
    if (few === undefined || many === undefined) throw new Error("missing height samples");
    expect(many.tabs).toBeCloseTo(few.tabs, 0);
    expect(many.subtitle).toBeCloseTo(few.subtitle, 0);
    expect(many.metrics).toBeCloseTo(few.metrics, 0);
  });
});

test.describe("record-detail-layout — tall tab panel scrolls", () => {
  test.use({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 772 } });

  test("an extension tab taller than the viewport scrolls its sections wrapper to the last element", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.goto("/?tab=internal-note&noteHeight=1400");
    const note = page.getByTestId("order-internal-note");
    await expect(note).toBeVisible();
    const end = page.getByTestId("order-internal-note-end");

    // Nearest scrollable ancestor of the panel content: the sections wrapper.
    const scroller = await note.evaluateHandle((el) => {
      let node: HTMLElement | null = el.parentElement;
      while (node !== null && !/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(node).overflowY)) {
        node = node.parentElement;
      }
      if (node === null) throw new Error("no scrollable ancestor");
      return node;
    });
    const metrics = () =>
      scroller.evaluate((el) => ({
        scrollHeight: el.scrollHeight,
        clientHeight: el.clientHeight,
        scrollTop: el.scrollTop,
      }));

    const before = await metrics();
    expect(before.scrollHeight).toBeGreaterThan(before.clientHeight);

    const box = await note.boundingBox();
    if (box === null) throw new Error("missing note bounding box");
    await page.mouse.move(box.x + 10, box.y + 10);
    await page.mouse.wheel(0, 3000);
    await expect.poll(async () => (await metrics()).scrollTop).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    await expect(end).toBeInViewport();
  });
});

test.describe("record-detail-layout — header action per tab", () => {
  const recordPayment = "Record payment";

  test("record-payment shows on the payments tab only", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/?tab=payments");
    await expect(page.getByTestId("kumiko-screen-projection-detail-tabs")).toBeVisible();
    // The third header action lands in the overflow menu.
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "More actions" }).last().click();
    await expect(page.getByRole("menuitem", { name: recordPayment })).toBeVisible();

    await page.goto("/?tab=items");
    await expect(page.getByTestId("render-list-table")).toBeVisible();
    // Only two actions remain, so no overflow menu is rendered.
    await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "More actions" })).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByRole("menuitem", { name: recordPayment })).toHaveCount(0);
  });
});
```

```ts
// Phone-viewport tab strip (fw#3234): order-detail's tabs Card frame must
// stay within the panel's own width on a narrow phone viewport — no
// horizontal document scroll from the tab strip or the Card chrome around
// it. Runs against the "chromium-phone" project (see playwright.config.ts),
// a real iPhone-sized viewport, not a resized desktop window.

import { expect, boundaryGuardedTest as test } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/e2e";

test("record-detail-layout — tab strip fits the phone viewport width", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/");
  await expect(page.getByTestId("render-edit-form")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("kumiko-screen-projection-detail-tabs")).toBeVisible();

  const overflowsHorizontally = await page.evaluate(
    () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth > document.documentElement.clientWidth,
  );
  expect(overflowsHorizontally).toBe(false);

  const tabsBox = await page
    .getByTestId("kumiko-screen-projection-detail-tabs")
    .evaluate((el) => ({ scrollWidth: el.scrollWidth, clientWidth: el.clientWidth }));
  expect(tabsBox.scrollWidth).toBeLessThanOrEqual(tabsBox.clientWidth);
});
```

### e2e/playwright.config.ts

```ts
// Playwright config for record-detail-layout/e2e. Boots the minimal
// build-server (see e2e/build-server.ts) — a real browser + real React
// bundle against a MockDispatcher, no full Kumiko stack. Pattern copied
// from samples/recipes/writeform-section/e2e/playwright.config.ts.
//
// Port 4190: see the build-server.ts comment for the port allocation
// overview of the other samples/apps ports.
//
// Config lives IN e2e/ itself — Playwright's webServer.command runs by
// default with cwd = the config's directory, i.e. relative to e2e/ itself
// (not to the package root). testDir therefore stays "." instead of
// "./e2e", and webServer.command calls build-server.ts without an "e2e/"
// prefix.

import { defineConfig, devices } from "@playwright/test";

// The padding-parity spec only captures screenshots for manual review (no
// regression assertions), so it stays out of regular runs and costs no runner
// minutes unless this flag is set.
const WITH_PARITY_SCREENSHOTS = !!process.env["PADDING_PARITY_SCREENSHOTS"];

const PORT = 4190;
const BASE_URL = `http://localhost:${PORT}`;

export default defineConfig({
  testDir: ".",
  testIgnore: ["**/fixtures/**", "build-server.ts"],
  fullyParallel: false,
  forbidOnly: !!process.env["CI"],
  retries: 0,
  workers: 1,
  reporter: [["list"]],
  timeout: 15_000,
  expect: { timeout: 3_000 },

  use: {
    baseURL: BASE_URL,
    trace: "retain-on-failure",
    screenshot: "only-on-failure",
    actionTimeout: 5_000,
    navigationTimeout: 10_000,
  },

  projects: [
    {
      name: "chromium",
      testIgnore: /(phone-viewport|padding-parity-screenshots|board-screenshots)\.spec\.ts$/,
      use: { ...devices["Desktop Chrome"], viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } },
    },
    // Desktop copy of padding-parity-screenshots.spec.ts, distinct from the
    // "chromium" project above (that one ignores it) so the screenshot spec
    // gets its own explicit project name instead of hiding in "chromium"'s
    // catch-all — matches the phone project's split for the same reason.
    ...(WITH_PARITY_SCREENSHOTS
      ? [
          {
            name: "chromium-desktop-screenshots",
            testMatch: /(padding-parity-screenshots|board-screenshots)\.spec\.ts$/,
            use: { ...devices["Desktop Chrome"], viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } },
          },
        ]
      : []),
    // Phone viewport (fw#3234): the tab strip must stay within the panel
    // width — no horizontal document scroll — down to a narrow phone frame.
    // Plain Desktop Chrome with an iPhone-sized viewport, not the "iPhone
    // 13" device preset (isMobile/hasTouch touch emulation is flaky in this
    // sandbox's headless chromium) — width is what fw#3234 cares about.
    {
      name: "chromium-phone",
      testMatch: WITH_PARITY_SCREENSHOTS
        ? /(phone-viewport|padding-parity-screenshots|board-screenshots)\.spec\.ts$/
        : /phone-viewport\.spec\.ts$/,
      use: { ...devices["Desktop Chrome"], viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } },
    },
  ],

  webServer: {
    command: "bun build-server.ts",
    url: BASE_URL,
    env: { PORT: String(PORT) },
    reuseExistingServer: !process.env["CI"],
    timeout: 30_000,
    stdout: "pipe",
    stderr: "pipe",
  },
});
```

```ts
// The orders work queue: named filters in one select with hit counts, a filter-owned sort,
// a filter-owned empty state with a reset button, and the summary row footer.

import { expect, boundaryGuardedTest as test } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/e2e";

const FILTER_FACET = "facet-__namedFilter";
// The open reason box renders as its own table row under the data row; count data rows only.
const DATA_ROWS = "tbody tr:not([data-reason-row])";

test("picking a named filter narrows the list and sorts it by the filter's own order", async ({
  page,

  await page.goto("/orders");
```

### src/__tests__/feature.test.ts

```ts
// Record Detail Layout Showcase — Unit Test (no DB / HTTP needed).
// Proves:
//   - header/metrics/tabs land on the registered ProjectionDetailScreenDefinition
//     exactly as declared (column names, not literals)
//   - relatedList columns collapse the string shorthand like entityList columns do
//   - the boot-validator catches the two mistakes the projectionDetail tabs
//     layout introduces: a metric with an empty label, and a tabs
//     layout with fewer than two sections

import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import {
  createRegistry,
  defineFeature,
  normalizeListColumn,
  validateBoot as validateBootRaw,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { withBootValidatorFixture } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/helpers";
import { z } from "zod";
import { createOrderDeskFeature } from "../feature";
import {
  answerBriefing,
  answerOrderDetail,
  answerOrderList,
  answerOrderSummary,
  orderListSchema,
  orderSummarySchema,
} from "../order-board";

function validateBoot(features: Parameters<typeof validateBootRaw>[0]): void {
  validateBootRaw(withBootValidatorFixture(features));
}

const orderDesk = createOrderDeskFeature();
const registry = createRegistry([orderDesk]);

describe("record-detail-layout showcase — registration", () => {
  test("validateBoot accepts the full registered app", () => {
    expect(() => validateBoot([orderDesk])).not.toThrow();
  });

  test("order-detail registers as projectionDetail with a qualified id", () => {
    const screen = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:order-detail");
    expect(screen?.type).toBe("projectionDetail");
  });

  test("header and metrics store column names, not literals", () => {
    const screen = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:order-detail");
    if (screen?.type !== "projectionDetail") throw new Error("expected projectionDetail");
    expect(screen.header).toEqual({
      title: "customerName",
      shortTitle: "shortTitle",
      narrowSubtitle: "narrowSubtitle",
      subtitle: [
        "orderNumber",
        { field: "placedAt", format: { format: "date", dateStyle: "medium" } },
      ],
      status: "status",
    });
    expect(screen.metrics?.map((metric) => metric.field)).toEqual([
      "totalAmount",
      "outstandingAmount",
      "itemCount",
      "placedAt",
    ]);
  });

  test("layout.mode is tabs with two relatedList sections, one fields section, and one extension section", () => {
    const screen = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:order-detail");
    if (screen?.type !== "projectionDetail") throw new Error("expected projectionDetail");
    expect(screen.layout.mode).toBe("tabs");
    expect(screen.layout.sections.map((s) => s.kind)).toEqual([
      "relatedList",
      "relatedList",
      "fields",
      "extension",
    ]);
  });

  test("screen-level actions carry refresh-order, inline download-invoice and the payments-only record-payment", () => {
    const screen = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:order-detail");
    if (screen?.type !== "projectionDetail") throw new Error("expected projectionDetail");
    expect(screen.actions?.map((a) => a.id)).toEqual([
      "refresh-order",
      "download-invoice",
      "record-payment",
    ]);
    expect(screen.inlineActions).toEqual(["download-invoice"]);
  });

  test("relatedList columns carry their own header label, there is no entity to resolve it from", () => {
    const screen = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:order-detail");
    if (screen?.type !== "projectionDetail") throw new Error("expected projectionDetail");
    const itemsSection = screen.layout.sections[0];
    if (itemsSection?.kind !== "relatedList") throw new Error("expected relatedList");
    expect(normalizeListColumn(itemsSection.columns[0]!)).toEqual({
      field: "sku",
      label: "order-desk.col.sku",
    });
  });
});

describe("record-detail-layout showcase — guidance", () => {
  test("the orders list carries rowToneField and a hint column", () => {
    const screen = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:orders");
    if (screen?.type !== "projectionList") throw new Error("expected projectionList");
    expect(screen.rowToneField).toBe("tone");
    const hint = screen.columns.map((c) => normalizeListColumn(c)).find((c) => c.hint);
    expect(hint?.hint?.detailField).toBe("nextStepDue");
  });

  test("the detail screen declares breadcrumb, summary, banner and steps from query fields", () => {
    const screen = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:order-detail");
    if (screen?.type !== "projectionDetail") throw new Error("expected projectionDetail");
    expect(screen.breadcrumb).toEqual({ field: "path" });
    expect(screen.summary).toEqual({
      field: "summaryLine",
      narrowField: "summaryShort",
      toneField: "summaryTone",
    });
    expect(screen.banner?.field).toBe("notice");
    expect(screen.steps?.field).toBe("steps");
    expect(screen.progress?.field).toBe("progress");
  });
});

describe("record-detail-layout showcase — work queue", () => {
  test("the orders list offers named filters as a counted select, with sort and empty state", () => {
    const screen = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:orders");
    if (screen?.type !== "projectionList") throw new Error("expected projectionList");
    expect(screen.namedFilters?.map((filter) => filter.id)).toEqual([
      "action-needed",
      "reminder-due",
      "ending-soon",
    ]);
    expect(screen.namedFilterFacet).toEqual({
      display: "select",
      showCounts: true,
      label: "order-desk.orders.todo",
    });
    const buttons = (screen.rowActions ?? []).filter((action) => action.display === "button");
    expect(buttons.map((action) => [action.id, action.visible])).toEqual([
      ["remind", { field: "canRemind", eq: true }],
      ["open-order", { field: "canRemind", eq: false }],
    ]);
    expect(screen.namedFilters?.[0]?.sort).toEqual({ field: "urgency", dir: "desc" });
    expect(screen.namedFilters?.[0]?.emptyState?.title).toBe("order-desk.orders.all-done");
    expect(screen.table?.totals).toBeUndefined();
  });

  test("the list query filters, sorts, counts and aggregates like the screen asks", () => {
    const ask = (payload: object) => answerOrderList(orderListSchema.parse(payload));
    const open = ask({ namedFilter: "action-needed", sort: "urgency", sortDirection: "desc" });
    if (!("rows" in open)) throw new Error("expected rows");
    expect(open.rows.map((row) => row.id)).toEqual(["o1", "o7", "o3", "o4", "o5"]);

    const counted = ask({ namedFilter: "action-needed", limit: 1, totalCount: true });
    if (!("rows" in counted)) throw new Error("expected rows");
    expect(counted.rows).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(counted.total).toBe(5);

    const none = ask({ namedFilter: "reminder-due", totalCount: true });
    if (!("rows" in none)) throw new Error("expected rows");
    expect(none.rows).toHaveLength(0);

    const totals = ask({
      aggregate: { measures: [{ field: "openAmount", kind: "sum" }] },
    });
    if (!("groups" in totals)) throw new Error("expected groups");
    expect(totals.groups[0]?.measures).toEqual([2497]);
  });

  test("the today dashboard counts through the list query and links into the filtered list", () => {
    const screen = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:today");
    if (screen?.type !== "dashboard") throw new Error("expected dashboard");
    expect(screen.panels.map((panel) => panel.kind)).toEqual([
      "text",
      "stat-group",
      "list",
      "list",
      "list",
      "stat-group",
    ]);
    const counts = screen.panels.find((panel) => panel.id === "queue-counts");
    if (counts?.kind !== "stat-group") throw new Error("expected stat-group");
    expect(counts.stats.map((stat) => stat.navigate?.namedFilter)).toEqual([
      "action-needed",
      "reminder-due",
      "ending-soon",
    ]);
  });
});

describe("record-detail-layout showcase — board gaps", () => {
  test("the orders list declares sort options, a summary query and a self-sizing hint column", () => {
    const screen = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:orders");
    if (screen?.type !== "projectionList") throw new Error("expected projectionList");
    expect(screen.sortOptions?.map((option) => [option.field, option.dir])).toEqual([
      ["urgency", "desc"],
      ["customerName", "asc"],
    ]);
    expect(screen.table?.summaryRow?.query).toBe("order-desk:query:order:summary");
    const hint = screen.columns.map((c) => normalizeListColumn(c)).find((c) => c.hint);
    expect([hint?.width, hint?.minWidth]).toEqual([320, 240]);
  });

  test("the summary query follows the named filter", () => {
    const all = answerOrderSummary(orderSummarySchema.parse({}));
    const open = answerOrderSummary(orderSummarySchema.parse({ namedFilter: "action-needed" }));
    expect(all.items[0]?.value).toBe(8);
    expect(open.items[0]?.value).toBe(5);
    expect(all.items.map((item) => item.label)).toEqual(["Orders", "Open", "Overdue"]);
  });

  test("the today board links its list and stat group and the detail places progress beside the steps", () => {
    const today = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:today");
    if (today?.type !== "dashboard") throw new Error("expected dashboard");
    const now = today.panels.find((panel) => panel.id === "now");
    if (now?.kind !== "list") throw new Error("expected the now list");
    expect(now.footerLink?.namedFilter).toBe("action-needed");
    const counts = today.panels.find((panel) => panel.id === "queue-counts");
    if (counts?.kind !== "stat-group") throw new Error("expected stat-group");
    expect([counts.layout, counts.link?.screen]).toEqual(["strip", "orders"]);

    const detail = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:order-detail");
    if (detail?.type !== "projectionDetail") throw new Error("expected projectionDetail");
    expect(detail.progress?.placement).toBe("beside-steps");
    expect(detail.metricsPlacement).toEqual({ narrow: "after-guidance" });
    expect(detail.metrics?.map((metric) => metric.subField)).toContain("totalNote");
  });
});

describe("record-detail-layout showcase — phone variants", () => {
  test("the today board limits, collapses and hides panels under sm", () => {
    const today = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:today");
    if (today?.type !== "dashboard") throw new Error("expected dashboard");
    const panel = (id: string) => today.panels.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
    const now = panel("now");
    const deadlines = panel("deadlines");
    if (now?.kind !== "list" || deadlines?.kind !== "list") throw new Error("expected lists");
    expect(now.narrow).toEqual({ layout: "cards", limit: 3 });
    expect(deadlines.narrow?.field).toBe("title");
    expect(deadlines.narrow?.moreText).toBe("order-desk.today.deadlines-more-narrow");
    expect(deadlines.icon).toEqual({ react: { __component: "DeadlinesIcon" } });
    expect(deadlines.footerLink?.narrowOnly).toBe(true);
    expect(deadlines.rowLink).toEqual({
      screenField: "screen",
      paramsField: "params",
      icon: "chevron",
    });
    expect(panel("customers")?.kind === "list" && panel("customers")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(panel("customers")?.hideOnNarrow).toBe(true);
    expect(panel("money")?.hideOnNarrow).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the detail shortens summary and steps and drops the chain under sm", () => {
    const detail = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:order-detail");
    if (detail?.type !== "projectionDetail") throw new Error("expected projectionDetail");
    expect(detail.steps?.narrowLimit).toBe(3);
    expect(detail.progress?.hideOnNarrow).toBe(true);
    expect(answerOrderDetail("o1").steps.length).toBeGreaterThan(3);
  });

  test("the board uses the round-5 phone and row options", () => {
    const today = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:today");
    if (today?.type !== "dashboard") throw new Error("expected dashboard");
    const customers = today.panels.find((candidate) => candidate.id === "customers");
    if (customers?.kind !== "list") throw new Error("expected the customers list");
    expect(customers.rowLink).toEqual({ screen: "order-detail", paramField: "params" });
    expect(customers.rowToneMarker).toBe("dot");
    expect(today.panels.find((candidate) => candidate.id === "briefing")?.narrowOrder).toBe(1);
    expect(answerOrderSummary(orderSummarySchema.parse({})).items.map((i) => i.column)).toEqual([
      "orderNumber",
      "openAmount",
      "urgencyLabel",
    ]);
  });

  test("the briefing answers a shorter variant for phones", () => {
    expect(answerBriefing().narrowBlocks.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

describe("record-detail-layout showcase — empty states", () => {
  test("the payments tab declares a record-dependent empty text ahead of its default", () => {
    const screen = registry.getScreen("order-desk:screen:order-detail");
    if (screen?.type !== "projectionDetail") throw new Error("expected projectionDetail");
    const payments = screen.layout.sections.find((section) => section.id === "payments");
    if (payments?.kind !== "relatedList") throw new Error("expected the payments relatedList");
    expect(payments.emptyState).toEqual({
      title: "order-desk.payments.empty",
      variants: [
        { when: { field: "status", eq: "pending" }, title: "order-desk.payments.empty-pending" },
      ],
    });
  });
});

describe("record-detail-layout showcase — boot-validator catches author mistakes", () => {
  test("metric with an empty label fails boot — no fallback to the raw column name", () => {
    const broken = defineFeature("broken-order-desk", (r) => {
      r.queryHandler({
        name: "order:detail",
        schema: z.object({ id: z.string() }),

      });
      r.screen({
        id: "order-detail",

      });
    });
    expect(() => validateBoot([broken])).toThrow(/metric "totalAmount" has no "label"/);
  });

  test("a hint column naming an empty detail field fails boot", () => {
    const broken = defineFeature("broken-order-desk-hint", (r) => {
      r.queryHandler({
        name: "order:list",
        schema: z.object({}),
        handler: async () => ({ rows: [] }),
        access: { openToAll: { reason: "test handler callable by any signed-in test user" } },
      });
      r.screen({
        id: "orders",
        type: "projectionList",
        query: "broken-order-desk-hint:query:order:list",
        columns: [{ field: "nextStep", hint: { detailField: "" } }],
      });
    });
    expect(() => validateBoot([broken])).toThrow(/list\/guidance-field-empty/);
  });

  test("tabs with only one section fails boot", () => {
    const broken = defineFeature("broken-order-desk-tabs", (r) => {
      r.queryHandler({
        name: "order:detail",
        schema: z.object({ id: z.string() }),
        handler: async () => ({ id: "1" }),
        access: { openToAll: { reason: "test handler callable by any signed-in test user" } },
      });
      r.screen({
        id: "order-detail",
        type: "projectionDetail",
        query: "broken-order-desk-tabs:query:order:detail",
        layout: {
          mode: "tabs",
          sections: [{ id: "only", title: "Only", fields: ["id"] }],
        },
      });
    });
    expect(() => validateBoot([broken])).toThrow(/tabs need at least 2 sections/);
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
// Record Detail Layout Showcase — a work queue, a briefing dashboard and a
// projectionDetail screen with the "Akte" (case file) layout:
//   1. `header` renders the query row's customer/order/status columns above
//      the layout — the identity a support agent scans first.
//   2. `metrics` renders a labeled band of key numbers from the same row; each metric
//      carries its own i18n `label`, there is no fallback to the raw column name. Tiles take a
//      fixed `tone` or a per-record `toneField` and can jump to a tab with `navigate`.
//   3. `layout.mode: "tabs"` splits the record into four tabs: two `relatedList`
//      sections (own query, own pagination, mounts only when active, badge via `countField`),
//      one `fields` section (master data) and one `extension` section (plugin-mounted component;
//      every tab kind sits in the same Card padding, no extra chrome).
//   4. The payments tab's emptyState picks its text from the order record through `variants`.
//   5. A screen-level `actions` entry (fw#3234) renders next to the header,
//      not inside any tab's Card. `inlineActions` keeps download-invoice a visible
//      button next to it where the page header would otherwise fold it into the menu.
//   6. `showOnTabs` limits the record-payment action to the payments tab.
//   7. Guidance: the `orders` projectionList tints rows via `rowToneField`, shows a
//      "to do" hint column (sentence, detail, tone, a "Why?" reason), a badge column and
//      per-row button actions (send a reminder, or open the record). Named filters sit in one select with hit counts,
//      each with its own sort and empty state; the summary row totals the rows. The detail screen adds
//      `breadcrumb`, `summary`, `banner` and `steps`, each reading a query field; empty values drop out.
//   8. The `today` dashboard composes a lead briefing, count tiles that link into the filtered
//      list, a headerless "Now" list and two narrow lists on a 12-column grid.
//   9. Phone variants: `hideOnNarrow` drops panels, a list panel's `narrow` turns it into limited cards or a
//      one-line link, `narrowBlocks` shortens the briefing, `showOnNarrowOnly` adds card-only meta, and the
//      detail shows `summary.narrowField`, `steps.narrowLimit` and no `progress` chain under sm.
//  10. `focus: true` gives the detail a focused shell; phones get a top bar with the
//      record title, a back arrow to the list and the page-header overflow menu.
//
// projectionDetail binds to an explicit query, not an entity: every field name below
// (header, metrics, fields) is a column of that query's row.

import { defineFeature, type FeatureDefinition } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { z } from "zod";
import {
  answerBriefing,
  answerCustomers,
  answerDeadlines,
  answerMoney,
  answerNowList,
  answerOrderDetail,
  answerOrderList,
  answerOrderSummary,
  orderListSchema,
  orderSummarySchema,
} from "./order-board.ts";

const rowIdSchema = z.object({ id: z.string() });
const noPayloadSchema = z.object({});
const accessRoles = { roles: ["Support", "Admin"] } as const;

export const ORDER_LIST_QUERY = "order-desk:query:order:list";

export function createOrderDeskFeature(): FeatureDefinition {
  return defineFeature("order-desk", (r) => {
    r.systemScope();

    r.queryHandler({
      name: "order:list",
      schema: orderListSchema,
      handler: async (query) => answerOrderList(query.payload),
      access: accessRoles,
    });

    r.queryHandler({
      name: "order:summary",
      schema: orderSummarySchema,
      handler: async (query) => answerOrderSummary(query.payload),
      access: accessRoles,
    });

    r.queryHandler({
      name: "order:now",
      schema: noPayloadSchema,
      handler: async () => answerNowList(),
      access: accessRoles,
    });

    r.queryHandler({
      name: "order:briefing",
      schema: noPayloadSchema,
      handler: async () => answerBriefing(),
      access: accessRoles,
    });

    r.queryHandler({
      name: "order:deadlines",
      schema: noPayloadSchema,
      handler: async () => answerDeadlines(),
      outputSchema: z.object({
        rows: z.array(
          z.object({
            id: z.string(),
            due: z.string(),
            title: z.string(),
            screen: z.string(),
            params: z.object({ entityId: z.string() }),
          }),
        ),
      }),
      access: accessRoles,
    });

    r.queryHandler({
      name: "order:customers",
      schema: noPayloadSchema,
      handler: async () => answerCustomers(),
      access: accessRoles,
    });

    r.queryHandler({
      name: "order:money",
      schema: noPayloadSchema,
      handler: async () => answerMoney(),
      access: accessRoles,
    });

    r.queryHandler({
      name: "order:detail",
      schema: rowIdSchema,
      handler: async (query) => answerOrderDetail(query.payload.id),
      access: accessRoles,
    });

    r.queryHandler({
      name: "order:items",
      schema: rowIdSchema,
      handler: async () => ({
        rows: [
          { sku: "KB-100", description: "Mechanical keyboard", quantity: 1, unitPrice: 148 },
          { sku: "MS-220", description: "Wireless mouse", quantity: 2, unitPrice: 45 },
          { sku: "PAD-01", description: "Desk mat", quantity: 1, unitPrice: 22 },
        ],
      }),
      access: accessRoles,
    });

    r.queryHandler({
      name: "order:payments",
      schema: rowIdSchema,
      handler: async () => ({
        rows: [
          { paidAt: "2026-08-21", amount: 936, method: "card", status: "settled" },
          { paidAt: "2026-08-25", amount: 312, method: "invoice", status: "pending" },
        ],
      }),
      access: accessRoles,
    });

    r.writeHandler({
      name: "order:remind",
      schema: rowIdSchema,
      handler: async (event) => ({ isSuccess: true as const, data: { id: event.payload.id } }),
      access: accessRoles,
    });

    r.translations({
      keys: {
        "screen:orders.title": { en: "Orders" },
        "screen:order-detail.title": { en: "Order" },
        "screen:today.title": { en: "Today" },
        "order-desk.orders.todo": { en: "To do" },
        "order-desk.orders.nothing-open": { en: "Nothing to do" },
        "order-desk.orders.all-done": { en: "All done" },
        "order-desk.orders.all-done-hint": { en: "No order needs you right now." },
        "order-desk.filter.action-needed": { en: "Needs action" },
        "order-desk.filter.reminder-due": { en: "Reminder due" },
        "order-desk.filter.ending-soon": { en: "Ending soon" },
        "order-desk.col.order": { en: "Order" },
        "order-desk.col.customer": { en: "Customer" },

        "order-desk.col.quantity": { en: "Quantity" },
        "order-desk.col.unit-price": { en: "Unit price" },
        "order-desk.col.paid-at": { en: "Paid on" },
        "order-desk.col.amount": { en: "Amount" },
        "order-desk.col.method": { en: "Method" },
        "order-desk.col.status": { en: "Status" },
        "order-desk.sort.urgency": { en: "Urgency" },

        "order-desk.today.stat.action-needed": { en: "Need action" },
        "order-desk.today.stat.reminder-due": { en: "Reminders due" },
        "order-desk.today.stat.ending-soon": { en: "Ending soon" },
        "order-desk.today.now-total": { en: "The {shown} most urgent of {total} orders" },
        "order-desk.today.now-total-narrow": { en: "{shown} of {total}" },

        "order-desk.action.open": { en: "Open" },
        "order-desk.action.remind": { en: "Send reminder" },
        "order-desk.action.open-order": { en: "Open order" },
        "order-desk.action.prepare": { en: "Let the assistant prepare" },
        "order-desk.action.recordPayment": { en: "Record payment" },
        "order-desk.action.refreshOrder": { en: "Refresh" },
        "order-desk.action.downloadInvoice": { en: "Download invoice" },
        "order-desk.steps.title": { en: "Next steps" },
        "order-desk.steps.empty": { en: "Nothing left to do" },

        "order-desk.tab.items": { en: "Items" },
        "order-desk.tab.payments": { en: "Payments" },
        "order-desk.tab.details": { en: "Details" },
        "order-desk.tab.internalNote": { en: "Internal note" },
        "order-desk.payments.empty": { en: "No payments yet" },
        "order-desk.payments.empty-pending": { en: "A payment is pending" },
      },
    });

    r.screen({
      id: "orders",
      type: "projectionList",
      query: ORDER_LIST_QUERY,
      rowToneField: "tone",
      columns: [
        { field: "orderNumber", label: "order-desk.col.order" },
        { field: "customerName", label: "order-desk.col.customer" },
        {
          field: "urgencyLabel",
          label: "order-desk.col.urgency",
          display: "badge",
          badgeToneField: "urgencyTone",
        },
        {
          field: "nextStep",
          label: "order-desk.col.todo",
          hint: {
            detailField: "nextStepDue",
            narrowDetailField: "nextStepShort",
            reasonField: "nextStepReason",
            reasonTitleField: "nextStepReasonTitle",
            reasonOpenField: "nextStepReasonOpen",
            emptyLabel: "order-desk.orders.nothing-open",
          },
          width: 320,

        },
        { field: "openAmount", label: "order-desk.col.open-amount", hideOnNarrow: true },
        { field: "narrowMeta", label: "order-desk.col.narrow-meta", showOnNarrowOnly: true },
      ],
      defaultSort: { field: "urgency", dir: "desc" },
      sortOptions: [
        { field: "urgency", dir: "desc", label: "order-desk.sort.urgency" },
        { field: "customerName", dir: "asc", label: "order-desk.sort.customer" },
      ],
      namedFilters: [
        {
          id: "action-needed",
          label: "order-desk.filter.action-needed",

            title: "order-desk.orders.all-done",
            description: "order-desk.orders.all-done-hint",
          },
        },
        { id: "ending-soon", label: "order-desk.filter.ending-soon" },
      ],
      namedFilterFacet: { display: "select", showCounts: true, label: "order-desk.orders.todo" },
      narrowFacets: "pills",
      table: {
        frame: "card",

      rowActions: [

    r.screen({
```

```ts
// In-memory order data shared by the real query handlers (feature.ts) and the e2e
// mock dispatcher, so the browser fixture answers exactly what the server would.

import { z } from "zod";

export const ORDER_DETAIL_SCREEN_QN = "order-desk:screen:order-detail";

export const NAMED_FILTER_IDS = ["action-needed", "reminder-due", "ending-soon"] as const;
export type OrderNamedFilterId = (typeof NAMED_FILTER_IDS)[number];

const AGGREGATE_MEASURE_KINDS = ["sum", "avg", "count", "min", "max"] as const;

export const orderListSchema = z.object({
  namedFilter: z.enum(NAMED_FILTER_IDS).optional(),
  search: z.string().optional(),
  sort: z.string().optional(),
  sortDirection: z.enum(["asc", "desc"]).optional(),
  limit: z.number().int().positive().max(200).optional(),
  offset: z.number().int().nonnegative().optional(),
  totalCount: z.boolean().optional(),
  aggregate: z
    .object({
      groupBy: z.string().optional(),
      measures: z
        .array(z.object({ field: z.string(), kind: z.enum(AGGREGATE_MEASURE_KINDS) }))
        .default([]),
    })
    .optional(),
});

export type OrderListPayload = z.infer<typeof orderListSchema>;

// The list sends its narrowing (named filter, search) to the summary query as well; limit and paging never reach it.
export const orderSummarySchema = z.object({
  namedFilter: z.enum(NAMED_FILTER_IDS).optional(),
  search: z.string().optional(),
});

export type OrderSummaryPayload = z.infer<typeof orderSummarySchema>;

type RowTone = "ok" | "warn" | "bad" | "critical" | "neutral";
type UrgencyTone = "negative" | "warn" | "neutral" | "positive";

export type OrderRow = {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly orderNumber: string;
  readonly customerName: string;
  readonly tone: RowTone;
  readonly urgency: number;
  readonly urgencyLabel: string;
  readonly urgencyTone: UrgencyTone;
  readonly nextStep: string;
  readonly nextStepDue: string;
  readonly nextStepReason: string;
  readonly nextStepReasonTitle?: string;
  readonly nextStepReasonOpen?: boolean;
  readonly openAmount: number;
  readonly status: "processing" | "shipped" | "closing" | "delivered";
  readonly actionLabel: string;
  readonly canRemind: boolean;
};

const ORDER_ROWS: readonly OrderRow[] = [
  {
    id: "o1",
    orderNumber: "SO-10482",
    customerName: "Aiko Tanaka",
    tone: "bad",
    urgency: 92,

    nextStepReason: "312 EUR is 14 days overdue.\nTwo earlier mails stayed unanswered.",
    nextStepReasonTitle: "Rule 10 · Payment overdue.",

    status: "processing",
    actionLabel: "Send reminder",
    canRemind: true,
  },
  {
    id: "o2",

    customerName: "Jonas Weber",
    tone: "ok",
    urgency: 0,
    urgencyLabel: "",
    urgencyTone: "neutral",
    nextStep: "",
    nextStepDue: "",
    nextStepReason: "",
    openAmount: 0,
    status: "delivered",
    actionLabel: "",
    canRemind: false,
  },
  {
    id: "o3",
    orderNumber: "SO-10484",
    customerName: "Maria Lopez",
    tone: "warn",
    urgency: 74,
    urgencyLabel: "Overdue",
    urgencyTone: "negative",
    nextStep: "Confirm the delivery slot",
    nextStepDue: "Tuesday",
    nextStepReason: "The carrier asked twice for a date.",
    openAmount: 180,
    status: "shipped",
    actionLabel: "Open order",
    canRemind: false,
  },
  {
    id: "o4",
    orderNumber: "SO-10485",
    customerName: "Tom Becker",
    tone: "warn",
    urgency: 61,
    urgencyLabel: "Urgent",
    urgencyTone: "warn",
    nextStep: "Call about the backorder",
    nextStepDue: "tomorrow",
    nextStepReason: "Two of five items are backordered.\nThe customer expects a full delivery.",
    openAmount: 540,
    status: "processing",
    actionLabel: "Open order",
    canRemind: false,
  },
  {
    id: "o5",
    orderNumber: "SO-10486",
    customerName: "Priya Nair",
    tone: "neutral",
    urgency: 35,
    urgencyLabel: "Due",
    urgencyTone: "neutral",
    nextStep: "Review the credit limit",
    nextStepDue: "next week",
    nextStepReason: "The open balance grew past the agreed limit.",
    openAmount: 1190,
    status: "closing",
    actionLabel: "Open order",
    canRemind: false,
  },
  {
    id: "o6",
    orderNumber: "SO-10487",
    customerName: "Lars Hansen",
    tone: "ok",
    urgency: 0,
    urgencyLabel: "",
    urgencyTone: "neutral",
    nextStep: "",
    nextStepDue: "",
    nextStepReason: "",
    openAmount: 0,
    status: "delivered",
    actionLabel: "",

  },

    urgency: 80,
    urgencyLabel: "Overdue",

    canRemind: true,
  },
  {

    tone: "ok",

    urgencyLabel: "",

    nextStep: "",
    nextStepDue: "",
    nextStepReason: "",
    openAmount: 95,
    status: "closing",
    actionLabel: "",
    canRemind: false,
  },
];

const NAMED_FILTER_PREDICATES: Readonly<Record<OrderNamedFilterId, (row: OrderRow) => boolean>> = {
  "action-needed": (row) => row.nextStep !== "",
  "reminder-due": (row) => row.canRemind && row.nextStepDue === "today",
  "ending-soon": (row) => row.status === "closing",
};

const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 50;

function matchesSearch(row: OrderRow, search: string | undefined): boolean {
  if (search === undefined || search === "") return true;
  const needle = search.toLowerCase();
  return (
    row.orderNumber.toLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
    row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(needle)
  );
}

function fieldValue(row: OrderRow, field: string): unknown {
  return Object.entries(row).find(([key]) => key === field)?.[1];
}

function compareRows(
  field: string,
  direction: "asc" | "desc",
): (a: OrderRow, b: OrderRow) => number {
  const sign = direction === "asc" ? 1 : -1;
  return (a, b) => {
    const left = fieldValue(a, field);
    const right = fieldValue(b, field);
    if (typeof left === "number" && typeof right === "number") return sign * (left - right);
    return sign * String(left).localeCompare(String(right));
  };
}

function filteredRows(payload: OrderListPayload): readonly OrderRow[] {
  const predicate =
    payload.namedFilter === undefined ? undefined : NAMED_FILTER_PREDICATES[payload.namedFilter];
  return ORDER_ROWS.filter(
    (row) => (predicate === undefined || predicate(row)) && matchesSearch(row, payload.search),
  );
}

function numericValues(rows: readonly OrderRow[], field: string): number[] {
  return rows.flatMap((row) => {
    const value = fieldValue(row, field);
    return typeof value === "number" ? [value] : [];
  });
}

function measureOf(
  kind: (typeof AGGREGATE_MEASURE_KINDS)[number],
  rows: readonly OrderRow[],
  field: string,
): number | null {
  if (kind === "count") return rows.length;
  const values = numericValues(rows, field);
  if (values.length === 0) return null;
  const sum = values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0);
  if (kind === "sum") return sum;
  if (kind === "avg") return sum / values.length;
  return kind === "min" ? Math.min(...values) : Math.max(...values);
}

export type OrderListAnswer =
  | {
      readonly groups: readonly {
        readonly key: null;
        readonly count: number;
        readonly measures: readonly (number | null)[];
      }[];
    }
  | {
      readonly rows: readonly (OrderRow & {
        readonly narrowMeta: string;
        readonly actionScreen?: string;
        readonly actionParams?: { readonly entityId: string };
      })[];
      readonly nextCursor: null;
      readonly total?: number;
    };

export function answerOrderList(payload: OrderListPayload): OrderListAnswer {
  const matching = filteredRows(payload);
  if (payload.aggregate !== undefined) {
    return {
      groups: [
        {
          key: null,
          count: matching.length,
          measures: payload.aggregate.measures.map((m) => measureOf(m.kind, matching, m.field)),
        },
      ],
    };
  }
  const ordered =
    payload.sort === undefined
      ? matching
      : [...matching].sort(compareRows(payload.sort, payload.sortDirection ?? "asc"));
  const offset = payload.offset ?? 0;
  const rows = ordered.slice(offset, offset + (payload.limit ?? DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE)).map((row) => ({
    ...row,
    narrowMeta: `${euro(row.openAmount)} open · ${row.status}`,
    nextStepShort: row.nextStepDue === "" ? "" : `${row.nextStepDue} · ${euro(row.openAmount)}`,
    ...(row.nextStep !== "" && {
      actionScreen: ORDER_DETAIL_SCREEN_QN,
      actionParams: { entityId: row.id },
    }),
  }));
  return {
    rows,
    nextCursor: null,
    ...(payload.totalCount === true && { total: matching.length }),
  };
}

export function answerOrderSummary(payload: OrderSummaryPayload) {
  const matching = filteredRows(payload);
  const overdue = matching.filter((row) => row.urgencyTone === "negative");
  return {
    items: [
      { label: "Orders", value: matching.length, column: "orderNumber" },
      {
        label: "Open",
        value: euro(matching.reduce((total, row) => total + row.openAmount, 0)),
        column: "openAmount",
      },
      {
        label: "Overdue",
        value: euro(overdue.reduce((total, row) => total + row.openAmount, 0)),
        tone: "bad",
        column: "urgencyLabel",
      },
    ],
  };
}

function actionNeededRows(limit: number): readonly OrderRow[] {
  return ORDER_ROWS.filter(NAMED_FILTER_PREDICATES["action-needed"])
    .sort(compareRows("urgency", "desc"))
    .slice(0, limit);
}

const NOW_LIST_LIMIT = 4;

export function answerNowList() {
  return {
    rows: actionNeededRows(NOW_LIST_LIMIT).map((row) => ({
      ...row,
      nextStepShort: `${row.nextStepDue} · ${euro(row.openAmount)}`,
      actionScreen: ORDER_DETAIL_SCREEN_QN,
      actionParams: { entityId: row.id },
    })),
    total: actionNeededRows(ORDER_ROWS.length).length,
  };
}

export function answerBriefing() {
  const open = actionNeededRows(ORDER_ROWS.length);
  const [first] = open;
  return {
    blocks: [
      {
        kind: "paragraph",
        emphasis: "lead",
        text: `${open.length} orders need you today.${
          first === undefined
            ? ""
            : ` Most pressing is ${first.orderNumber} from ${first.customerName}.`
        }`,
      },
      {
        kind: "hint",
        text: "Sorted by urgency. Open an order and let the assistant prepare the step.",
      },
    ],
    narrowBlocks: [
      { kind: "paragraph", emphasis: "lead", text: `${open.length} orders need you today.` },
      { kind: "hint", text: "Tuesday, 3 November · as of 06:00" },
    ],
  };
}

const DEADLINES = [
  { id: "d1", due: "2026-11-06T09:00:00Z", title: "Reminder SO-10482", orderId: "o1" },

  return {
    rows: [...DEADLINES]
      .sort((a, b) => a.due.localeCompare(b.due))
      .map((deadline) => ({

        screen: ORDER_DETAIL_SCREEN_QN,

}

function euro(amount: number): string {
  return `€ ${amount.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
}

export function answerMoney() {
  const open = ORDER_ROWS.reduce((total, row) => total + row.openAmount, 0);
  const overdue = ORDER_ROWS.filter((row) => row.urgencyTone === "negative").reduce(
    (total, row) => total + row.openAmount,
    0,
  );
  return {
    open: euro(open),
    overdue: euro(overdue),
    collected: euro(1860),
    openOrders: String(ORDER_ROWS.filter((row) => row.openAmount > 0).length),
  };
}
```
